hero.headline: Production-ready foundation
hero.title: Launch your next application faster
hero.description: A secure Laravel and Vue platform with authentication, access control, and operations tooling built in - so your team can focus on the product, not the plumbing.

features.title: Everything a serious application needs, from day one
features.description: Placeholder marketing copy - replace these value propositions with your product's own story.
features.security_description: Passwords, magic links, two-factor authentication, and single sign-on through any OIDC identity provider.
features.access_description: Granular roles and permissions with an admin console for managing users, roles, and protected records.
features.settings_description: Profile, preferences, active sessions, connected identities, and personal access tokens - managed by the user.
features.audit_description: Authentication logs, administrative action auditing, and new-device alerts, available out of the box.
features.localization_description: English and Romanian shipped as first-class locales, with a translation pipeline ready for more.
features.operations_description: Queues on Horizon, health probes, security diagnostics, and high-availability Redis topologies.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every account with its roles and directly granted permissions.
users.filters_description: Narrow the user list. New filters will show up here as they become available.
users.not_found_description: The requested user does not exist or could not be loaded.
users.force_reset_description: A secure temporary password is generated for this user. Share it through a trusted channel — all of their sessions are signed out, and they must choose a new password at their next sign-in.
users.copy_failed: Copying failed — select and copy the password manually
users.force_reset_hint: Copy the password before closing — it will not be shown again.
users.require_two_factor_description: The user must set up an authenticator app before using the app; until then they can only reach the enrollment screen.
users.require_two_factor_enrolled_description: Already enrolled — the requirement ensures they must set two-factor up again if their factor is ever reset or disabled.
users.lift_two_factor_description: Two-factor authentication becomes optional for this account again. An existing enrollment keeps working.
users.reset_two_factor_description: Clears the authenticator and recovery codes, for when the device is lost. The user keeps signing in with their remaining methods and is notified by email.
users.impersonate_description: Open the app as this user to see exactly what they see. The session is audited; account administration, tokens and credential changes stay blocked until you exit.
users.impersonate_confirm_description: You will browse the app as this user until you exit. Start and end are recorded in the audit trail.
users.delete_description: The account is permanently retired: every session is signed out, API tokens and linked identities are revoked, and the email address is anonymized and freed for a new registration. A hashed membership record and the audit trail are kept. This cannot be undone.
users.deleted_banner_description: Deleted on {date}. The record is read-only: credentials and linked identities were severed, and the email address was anonymized and freed for re-registration. The logs below remain for accountability.
users.membership_description: Find out whether an email address is an account now — or was one before deletion.
users.membership_active: This address belongs to an existing account.
users.membership_deleted: This address belonged to an account that has since been deleted.
users.membership_none: This address has never been an account.
users.transfer_inherited_hint: Permissions marked inherited are already granted through a role; assigning one directly keeps it even if the role is later removed.
users.danger_description: Force a password reset or delete the account. These take effect immediately.
users.roles_description: Roles assigned to this user. Permissions granted through a role are inherited.
users.permissions_description: Permissions granted directly to this user, independent of any role.
users.sessions_description: Devices currently signed in to this account.
users.log_description: Recent authentication events for this account.
users.mark_verified_description: Treat the email address as confirmed without the user clicking a verification link.
users.add_user_description: Create an account and choose how the person receives their first sign-in.
users.delivery_description: How the person receives their first sign-in.
users.delivery_invitation_hint: A single-use sign-in link is emailed to the address above; no password is involved.
users.delivery_invitation_password_hint: A single-use link is emailed to the address above; the user chooses their password at first sign-in.
users.delivery_temp_password: Temporary password, shared out of band
users.delivery_temp_password_hint: A server-generated password is shown to you once; the user must change it at first sign-in.
users.no_delivery_available: Account creation is unavailable: password sign-in and invitation emails are both disabled for this deployment, so there is no way to hand a new account over.
users.invitation_sent_to: An invitation has been emailed to {email}. The link signs them in once and expires on its own; you can resend it from the user's actions if needed.
users.resend_invitation_description: Emails a fresh first-sign-in link and revokes the previous one.
users.delete_selected_description: Each selected account is permanently retired: signed out everywhere, its API tokens and linked identities revoked, and its email address anonymized and freed for a new registration. Hashed membership records and the audit trail are kept. This cannot be undone.
users.activate_description: Restore the account's ability to sign in.
users.deactivate_description: The account keeps its data and grants but cannot sign in until reactivated.
users.ban_description: Banned accounts are blocked from signing in and their sessions stop working. An optional reason is recorded for administrators.
users.unban_description: Clear the ban and its reason; the user can sign in again.
